title: Global $\mathcal{O}\left(k^{-2}\right)$ Convergence of Multilevel Gradient-Regularized Newton Methods
abstract: arXiv:2610.35195v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop and analyze multilevel gradient-regularized Newton methods for unconstrained convex optimization with Lipschitz-continuous Hessians. By computing Newton corrections in lower-dimensional subspaces, the proposed methods aim to reduce computational costs while preserving the global $\mathcal{O}\left(k^{-2}\right)$ convergence rate in function values of the full-space method. To establish this rate for multilevel methods, we introduce a class of row-nested restriction operators that ensures monotonicity of the reduced-gradient norms across levels. Numerical experiments with row-nested operators demonstrate convergence behavior comparable to full-space gradient-regularized Newton, while offering substantial computational savings on large-scale instances.

translated_title: 多层梯度正则化牛顿方法的全局 $\mathcal{O}\left(k^{-2}\right)$ 收敛性
translated_abstract: 我们针对具有利普希茨连续海森矩阵的无约束凸优化问题，开发并分析了多层梯度正则化牛顿方法。通过在低维子空间中计算牛顿修正项，所提出的方法旨在降低计算成本，同时保持全空间方法在函数值上的全局 $\mathcal{O}\left(k^{-2}\right)$ 收敛速率。为了给多层方法建立这一收敛速率，我们引入了一类行嵌套限制算子，以确保各层之间约化梯度范数的单调性。使用行嵌套算子的数值实验表明，该方法具有与全空间梯度正则化牛顿方法相当的收敛行为，同时在大规模算例上提供了显著的计算节省。
tldr: 本文提出了适用于利普希茨连续海森矩阵无约束凸优化的多层梯度正则化牛顿方法，通过在低维子空间中计算牛顿修正并引入行嵌套限制算子，在大幅降低计算成本的同时实现了全局 $\mathcal{O}(k^{-2})$ 收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper develops multilevel gradient-regularized Newton methods for unconstrained convex optimization with Lipschitz-continuous Hessians, achieving global $\mathcal{O}(k^{-2})$ convergence while substantially reducing computational costs by computing Newton corrections in lower-dimensional subspaces via row-nested restriction operators.
